parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no documented targeting of trans people by police or border officers, and no documented LGBT-specific abuse in the 2015 report. The 2019 Gender Equality Act prohibits gender-identity discrimination in goods and services and mandates official sensitisation, but the dossier does not show it being enforced, so it is a paper protection with partial weight. The 2008 judicial code adds a modest signal. Same-sex union and marriage gaps are resident-facing and not scored. The dossier is thin on visitor-facing matters: no document-marker rules, no screening evidence, no facility rules, no violence statistics, no care-access data. Extrapolating from the non-criminalising regime and the statutory protection, with thin-data uncertainty held in check, places it in the reduced-risk band. Acceptance evidence is limited to one initiative, so it stays below the higher tiers.
